x-groups.title: TLS
x-groups.description: How connections use TLS, in place of the dsn's tls parameter.

x-groups.title: Change data capture
x-groups.description: Only for tables read with cdc.

dsn.title: Connection string
dsn.description: A DSN as the Go MySQL driver spells it, or a mysql:// or mariadb:// URL. Sessions are in utf8mb4, in UTC, in the connector's SQL mode, without a sql_select_limit and with autocommit on, whatever its charset, time_zone, sql_mode, sql_select_limit and autocommit say; a collation of utf8mb4's is kept. Each other parameter the driver does not take must set a session variable.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database whose tables are offered as streams. Default: the DSN's database.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The tables to offer as streams. Empty: every table in the database.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: How connections use TLS, the binlog connection's too, in place of the dsn's tls parameter. Leave it out to go by the dsn.

oneOf.title: Preferred
oneOf.description: TLS if the server has it, without verifying its certificate; plaintext otherwise.

oneOf.title: Required
oneOf.description: TLS, without verifying the server's certificate.

oneOf.title: Verify CA
oneOf.description: TLS, with a certificate signed by ca.

oneOf.title: Verify identity
oneOf.description: As verify-ca, and the certificate names the dsn's host.

ca.title: CA certificates
ca.description: PEM certificates of the authorities that sign the server's certificate, for verify-ca and verify-identity. Empty: the system's.

cert.title: Client certificate
cert.description: A client certificate, PEM, for a user created with REQUIRE X509 or REQUIRE SUBJECT. Needs key.

key.title: Client key
key.description: The client certificate's private key, PEM, unencrypted.

snapshotChunkRows.title: Snapshot chunk rows
snapshotChunkRows.description: Rows per chunk of a cdc table's snapshot. Each chunk's rows are share-locked while it's read, and held in memory until the binlog reaches it, a chunk per connection reading it.

serverId.title: Server ID
serverId.description: The server ID the binlog connection presents, which must differ from every replica's of the server: MariaDB ends a binlog connection when another connects with its server ID, and the read fails. Default: one derived from the pipeline's name, at or above 2147483648.

chunkRows.title: Chunk rows
chunkRows.description: Rows per query on a table with a primary key; each chunk ends at a resume point.

batchBytes.title: Batch bytes
batchBytes.description: Approximate bytes of values per Arrow batch.

maxConnections.title: Max connections
maxConnections.description: The most connections a read holds to read tables, as many as it has lanes up to this. A cdc read's binlog connection is one more.
